project_type: Static HTML/CSS/JS website hosted on Cloudflare (wrangler.jsonc)
build_system: No build system - static files served directly. Deployment via Cloudflare Pages/wrangler.
test_framework: None - static site with no tests
test_command: N/A - validate HTML files exist and are well-formed
verification_instructions: 1. Verify all new/modified HTML files exist. 2. Verify images are copied to public/assets/. 3. Verify CSS color changes are applied. 4. Verify links in header, footer, and index reference the new syariah page.
environment_constraints: Open internet access available. No build step required.
key_patterns: Pages use shared header.html and footer.html loaded via JS (main.js). Each product page has inline <style> for page-specific CSS. Pages follow a common structure: hero section, content sections, CTA, footer. CSS variables defined in /public/assets/style.css with --jade as primary brand color. Dark mode supported via html.dark class.
